headline.text: L3 ML4 faced *7 hours* of intermittent downtime overnight across mold jams and equipment failures—most cleared by morning, but nozzle plate leak and worn belts remain open

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 3 MD belt fault cleared quickly after finding chocolate buildup under bin wheels causing plastic scraping. Label machine roller arm tightened. Minor housekeeping gaps flagged.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML3 had three belt failures across shifts—all replaced and running within 10 to 90 minutes. ML2 basket #2 issue persists after second shift repair attempt. Plastic mold shavings found in catch trays, cleaned out.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 overnight was rough: WDS electrical fault, pump motor failure, mold jams from paternoster misalignment, and two barrel lifts down—most cleared by morning. Truffle Line guillotine worn belts ordered. ML1 ran clean with one small hopper leak routed to 3rd shift.

notes.text: Flavor item 10045 inventory reconciled—enough for approximately 5 shifts of production.
Box item 41012 emergency order fulfilled within 90 minutes via internal transfer from Orem.
Chiller temp reduced to 38°F on ML1 yielded 4-5 degree improvement in cold water control and temper results.

resolved.title: S3 MD belt staying open with fault
resolved.summary: Metal detector belt would not retract properly, blocking production flow due to dirty proximity switches and chocolate buildup under bin wheels scraping plastic.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:26—prox switches cleaned and aligned, floor buildup removed, added to CILT schedule (Justin Garner, Chris Jeffs).

resolved.title: S3 label machine roller arm loose
resolved.summary: One roller arm came loose causing stops and accumulation on the line.
resolved.resolution: Tightened at 09:54, labeler working better now (Troy Baxter).

resolved.title: ML3 demolder belt snapped
resolved.summary: Belt snapped off in demolding area requiring replacement.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 05:40—two new belts installed, vacuumed all broken pieces (Fernando Flores).

resolved.title: ML2 double pieces from blades
resolved.summary: Blades were not clean causing double pieces to come through, line stopped.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:18—blades and tray cleaned, line running again (ML2 FW).

resolved.title: ML2 plastic mold shavings in catch trays
resolved.summary: Pieces of plastic from mold wear found in catch trays around demolder, line stopped for inspection and cleaning.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 04:50—catch trays cleaned out, no product affected, line running (Alex Mendoza, Jose Cabrera).

resolved.title: ML3 mold jam in demolder
resolved.summary: Molds jammed in the demolding area stopping production.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 04:45—line was down 9 minutes (Gustavo Rodas).

resolved.title: ML3 maintenance work in demolding
resolved.summary: Line stopped for maintenance work in the demolding area.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:20—line running again after 1.5 hours (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: ML3 drive roller belt snapped
resolved.summary: Drive roller belt snapped requiring replacement.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:42—belt replaced, line back up after 10 minutes (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: ML2 chicane belt rollers dirty
resolved.summary: Chicane belt rollers needed cleaning, line stopped.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:08—cleaned and line running (Mathew Draper).

resolved.title: ML4 WDS electrical fault at slide inserter
resolved.summary: WDS down with fault on slide inserter and depositor 3 screen not powering on, stopping production.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 23:26—defective safety card identified and reseated, WDS Germany commissioned remotely, line able to start (Ray Garcia, Spencer Andrus).

resolved.title: ML4 mold jams in cooling cabinet 4
resolved.summary: Molds jamming at cooling cabinet 4 top transfer due to paternoster pressing on infeed rail from uneven positioning.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:31—paternoster reference position moved forward 2 degrees to lessen pressure, will require full adjustment when empty (Kavin Ayala).

resolved.title: ML4 ingredient pump motor overheated
resolved.summary: Cream ingredient transfer pump motor overheated and stopped, storage tank at 50 percent.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:01—pump motor replaced, ATP passed, depositing resumed (Jose Vasquez, Gina Vazquez).

resolved.title: MF Matrix buckets not detecting product
resolved.summary: Matrix machine stopped detecting product preventing pouch filling.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 19:37—powered off and on, manually cycled one bucket then started working again (Tyson Fausett, Spencer Andrus).

resolved.title: ML4 demolding broken bars
resolved.summary: Broken bars being demolded, risk of defective product in stream.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 20:47—pulse duration adjusted 350ms to 320ms, dual EE inspection stations in place, checkweigher tested and confirmed rejects (Angel Cabrera).

resolved.title: ML1 right stirrer not spinning
resolved.summary: Right side stirrer on ML1 stopped spinning.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 22:00—maintenance working on it, implied fixed from context (Imperial).

resolved.title: ML4 feed drive belt misaligned
resolved.summary: Feed drive belt misaligned stopping depositing.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 02:00—belt realigned, depositing again (Kimberly Morales).

resolved.title: ML4 barrel dump lifts both out of service
resolved.summary: Both barrel lifts out of service at shift start, could not fill ingredient tanks.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:07—one charger bad, one had blown fuse; fuse replaced, one lift working and second charging (Nelson Cook).

resolved.title: ML4 sticker machine spin wheel loose
resolved.summary: Sticker machine spin wheel clamp came loose causing centering and adhesion issues.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 02:00—Jose adjusted spin wheel and tightened clamp (Phillip Perez).

resolved.title: Truffle Line enrober curtain coupling detached
resolved.summary: Small pipe coupling fell off enrober curtain and was found inside, cleaned but cannot reinstall during production due to chocolate pressure.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:54—coupling cleaned and passed ATP/visual, action added for 3rd shift to reinstall during reheat (Grey Boscan).

needs_attention.title: S3 lower pipes not removed during cleaning
needs_attention.summary: Lower pipes on Sollich 3 were not removed during the most recent cleaning cycle.
needs_attention.status: Flagged at 07:20 to Curt Willis, Dakota Adair, and Jody Howse; no follow-up action posted.

needs_attention.title: Missing smocks at changing stations
needs_attention.summary: Production floor changing stations are missing a lot of smocks and need restocking.
needs_attention.status: Jorel Gourdin acknowledged at 07:59; no restock confirmation posted.

needs_attention.title: ML3 supersack scale tare weight issue
needs_attention.summary: Tare weight reading too high on supersack scale, supposed to be 54-60 lbs but reading higher; maintenance calibrated but issue returned immediately on next supersack.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance calibrated but issue persisted as of 13:32 on 21st; no further updates in window.

needs_attention.title: ML2 basket #2 not working
needs_attention.summary: Basket number 2 on ML2 is not working; checked and maintenance notified but remains non-functional.
needs_attention.status: Still having problems as of 18:54 on 22nd; Brandon Lance and Mathew Draper aware.

needs_attention.title: ML4 partial pallet hold for insufficient salt
needs_attention.summary: Partial pallet placed on hold due to insufficient salt on product.
needs_attention.status: Pallet separated and held as of 00:28; Jody Howse and Dakota Adair notified; no resolution posted.

needs_attention.title: ML4 depositor 4 nozzle plate leak
needs_attention.summary: Depositor 4 nozzle plate leaking chocolate; washer on bolt broken and replaced but leak persists.
needs_attention.status: Washer replaced from depositor 3 at 05:44 but still leaking as of 06:00; maintenance working on it.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line guillotine belt wear causing miscuts
needs_attention.summary: Guillotine outfeed belt and curved conveyor have uneven surfaces from wear causing pieces to move out of place, creating doubles and misshapen product affecting Cavannas.
needs_attention.status: Conveyor roll ordered, will arrive in next few days; 4-hour install required; product coming out better after temp adjustment as of 11:04 (Rich Brierley, Nathan Ruiz).

needs_attention.title: ML1 small leak between hopper and pump block
needs_attention.summary: Very small leak discovered between the hopper and pump block on ML1.
needs_attention.status: Confirmed as very small leak at 11:27; cleaning every 2 hours, action added for 3rd shift inspection and repair if needed (Grey Boscan, Shawn Jewkes).
